[[File:ShadowSpawnZoom.jpg|thumb|A Pawn wearing a Shadow Crown.]]
The '''Shadow Crown''', nicknamed the ''Moon Hat'', was the realization of many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of research into [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore by [[Cronal]]. This crystalline "hat" would be worn by a mortal being whom Cronal could choose to inhabit to extend his existence, rather than [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious']] technique of using a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body to cheat [[Death/Legends|death]]. Using his Shadow Crown, Cronal submitted his devotion to the [[Way of the Dark]]. Cronal would connect directly to the Shadow Crown with his own version, called the '''Sunset Crown'''.

==Description==
Cronal's Shadow crown operated similarly to the [[Shadow Crown|shadow crowns]] of the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]. They acted as transmitters and receivers of Cronal's will, but facilitated this connection with [[Mindor/Legends|Mindorese]] [[meltmassif]] rather than [[Nihil smokestone]]. When worn, the crown would project a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] representation of Cronal over the face of the wearer, activated by several hundred pointed crystals that projected into the skull of the wearer. Once activated, the crown would concentrate the Dark Side of the Force on the individual, allowing Cronal to control them. Luke Skywalker noted that it was a heavy object, at over two [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].

The crown, however, proved to be very dangerous to its controller, especially regarding its meltmassif-controlling properties should the connection be interrupted. This is ultimately how Cronal was killed, when Luke Skywalker managed to stop his control over the crown, causing Cronal to be covered in meltmassif via his own orafices, petrifying him and his ship in Hyperspace, resulting in their disintegration.

==History==
Cronal traveled into the far reaches of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] via his [[Darksight]] vision, and visited such sites as the [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]], [[Valtaullu Rift/Legends|Valtaullu Rift]], and the [[Temple of Korman Lao]]. There, he discovered information and knowledge that led him to the tomb of [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] in the [[Valley of Golg]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. The knowledge he acquired at the Temple allowed Cronal to access the spirit of Graush and learn of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] that could create a device which would control a living [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], Mindorese meltmassif. Cronal would form a larger structure of this substance, and in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Cronal chose [[Nick Rostu]] to wear the Shadow Crown and be his chief [[Pawn]], "Shadowspawn." However, he soon decided that in order to restore the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] under a new leader, he would need a far greater being to wear the crown, namely [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
